data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ‘frēdēr’, meaning ‘peaceful’ or ‘protector’. In ancient Greece, the name Freda was given to girls born to noble families, symbolizing their role as protectors and rulers of their households. The name Freda carries the meaning “Peaceful ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Freda usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Freda total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
